name: empirio.ai
description:
empirio.ai is a platform for modern surveys and forms. This connector lets Claude write your questions, pull live responses, and run the analysis, taking you from first question to final report without leaving your chat.
 
What you can do
Build in seconds: "Create a 10-question employee engagement survey with rating scales and one open-ended question"
Track responses: "How many people finished the survey this week, and where are they dropping off?"
Analyze on the spot: "Cross-tabulate question 3 by department and tell me what stands out"
Report without the busywork: "Export the charts as PowerPoint and summarize the open-ended answers"
 
Built for every kind of survey: employee surveys, customer feedback, market research, event registration, and everyday online forms, with 35+ question types, ready-made questionnaire templates, and multilingual surveys. Works the same whether you're running a private poll, freelancing solo, or working inside a larger organization.
 
Getting started: Create a free account at empirio.ai and connect in one click. No credit card and no trial clock, just a free plan that keeps working, with paid plans available whenever you need more. EU-hosted and GDPR-compliant, with a data processing agreement in place from the first second, on every plan including the free one.

_published_faq.name: How do I add empirio.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add empirio.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://platform.empirio.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the empirio.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: empirio.ai lists 16 MCP tools, including responses_aggregates, responses_crosstab, responses_delete, responses_export, responses_export_charts, responses_list, responses_survey_stats, survey_create, survey_delete, survey_duplicate, survey_edit, and survey_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to empirio.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to empirio.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
empirio.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
empirio.ai is developed by empirio.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
